en: Black‑and‑white view of a neo‑Gothic church with a large square tower, pointed roofs, rose windows and an ornate portal opening onto a mostly empty cobblestone square. To the left stands a multi‑storey Gothic‑revival building with many pointed gables and a tall slender spire. A small tree is in front of the church; surrounding buildings appear historic and European. The image is framed like an old photographic postcard, with white borders and some handwritten marks along the bottom edge.
